text: {"findings":[{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required pay/incentive guardrails absent","detail":"The proposal introduces a surge incentive (a pay lever) but its only guardrail is neighboring-zone Driver Acceptance Rate. Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate and Cost Per Delivery are all missing.","evidence_quote":"Driver Acceptance Rate in neighboring zones: should not drop.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Add Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate and Cost Per Delivery as guardrails with explicit stop thresholds."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-021 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-021 tested a peak-hour surge incentive and found that adjacent zones lost drivers and that zone-level A/B overstated the lift. The proposal does not reference or learn from it.","evidence_quote":"Launch a surge incentive during peak hours across all markets and watch the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive"],"recommendation":"Cite EXP-021, explain how this differs, and adopt its learnings (market or switchback design, neighbor tracking, Cost Per Delivery tracking)."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No Legal and Compensation review recorded","detail":"A surge incentive is a driver pay change, which requires Legal and Compensation review because of contractor classification and pay-transparency risk. The proposal states that there are no reviews.","evidence_quote":"## Reviews And Dependencies\nNone.","citations":["policy-compliance#driver-compensation-and-classification"],"recommendation":"Obtain and record Legal and Compensation review before launch."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No experiment plan; full rollout with dashboard monitoring","detail":"The plan has no control, no market, geo or switchback design, no MDE or power, no stopping rule, and no stated duration. Pay changes interfere across the shared driver pool, and monitoring a dashboard invites peeking.","evidence_quote":"None. We will roll out to all markets and monitor the dashboard.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration","experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference","experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Run a market-level or switchback test for at least 14 days, pre-registered with the primary metric, MDE, power and stopping rule."}]}
